title: Indiana's 7th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for Indiana's 7th Congressional District pits Democratic incumbent U.S. Rep. André Carson, seeking a tenth term, against Republican nominee Patrick McAuley, a commercial real estate developer. The district covers all of Marion County, including Indianapolis, and is the most racially diverse congressional district in Indiana, with nearly one-third of residents identifying as Black and 16% as Hispanic. The primaries took place on May 5, 2026; Carson defeated three Democratic challengers and McAuley won the Republican primary. The Cook Political Report rates the race as Solidly Democratic, but the contest follows a high-profile 2025 attempt by President Donald Trump and Indiana Republicans to redraw the district's boundaries to favor Republicans, a plan that ultimately failed in the state Senate.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race as of June 2026. The Cook Political Report rates the district as Solidly Democratic.

candidates.name: André Carson
candidates.summary: André Carson is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Indiana's 7th Congressional District, first elected in a 2008 special election to succeed his grandmother, Rep. Julia Carson. He serves on the House Intelligence Committee and the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, and is a Senior Whip for the House Democratic Caucus. Before Congress, he served on the Indianapolis City-County Council, worked in law enforcement, and served at the Indiana Intelligence Fusion Center focusing on counter-terrorism.

candidates.name: Patrick McAuley
candidates.summary: Patrick McAuley is the Republican nominee for Indiana's 7th Congressional District. He works in commercial real estate development at Broad Ripple Capital, Inc. in Indianapolis. His campaign priorities include addressing infrastructure, public safety, housing affordability, job growth, and homelessness. He has previous experience on Capitol Hill working for a U.S. senator and holds a degree in religious studies from Wabash College.
